data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure (From, To, trip type and dates, Search, Continue, Sort & Filter), but it leaves out the payment type (cash or points) parameter and the sort option parameter, and it hardcodes "price low to high" instead, so an automation would need guesses for the sort step and the points toggle.
